title: Higher Education Leadership & Governance
subtitle: a graduate-level guide to leading a college or university, with an institution explorer, a budget allocator and a four-frame quiz
problem: New deans, directors and aspiring presidents learn the university from inside one unit and are surprised by the rest: a board that will not manage, a faculty senate that will not be managed, a budget in which the largest line is a discount, an accreditor whose 'voluntary' review decides whether federal aid arrives. The vocabulary of shared governance and net tuition is heard in meetings long before it is understood.
solution: A sixteen-section resource that maps the landscape and six institution types, shared governance role by role, Bolman and Deal's frames applied to one department closure, four leadership theories, finance and enrollment management, student development theory and the functional areas of student affairs, equity and campus climate, change and crisis, the legal domains, assessment and accreditation — with an institution explorer, a budget allocator that keeps every slice summing to 100% and judges the result, and a which-frame-is-this quiz.
pedagogy: one institution, many lenses: the explorer, budget and frame quiz all return to how a single campus decision looks from each seat at the table; the law and accreditation sections are orientations with sources, not advice; a glossary closes the loop.

widgets.name: Institution explorer
widgets.what: Six tabs — community college, regional comprehensive, research university, liberal arts, minority-serving, for-profit — with mission, students, funding and governance

widgets.name: Four-frame tabs
widgets.what: Structural, human-resource, political and symbolic readings of one scenario: closing a low-enrollment department

widgets.name: Which frame is this?
widgets.what: Short scenarios to classify by frame, with an explanation and a running score

widgets.name: Budget allocator
widgets.what: Sliders for instruction, academic support, student services, administration and more; moving one rescales the others so the total stays at 100%, then a verdict describes the priorities implied

quiz_topics: the board's fiduciary role under shared governance
tour: the first section opens and the count rises.
governance, net tuition, yield, accreditation and the four frames
